title: End-of-day close checklist
summary: Roll the day on the terminals, verify 86 clears and cash/charge totals reconcile per the operator reference.

steps.title: Run EOD reports
steps.instructions: Terminal: End of Day > roll the business day; verify no open shifts and every drawer closed. Keep the EOD packet with the audit files.

steps.title: Confirm the 86 list reset for tomorrow
steps.instructions: The shift-scoped 86s should not survive into the next open unless intentionally carried.

steps.title: Snapshot channel/workbench state for the log
